reference.approval: Evan: That generation is perfect for the starters. (2026-10-17)

processing: Source PNG bytes are unchanged. measure_frames.py reads alpha to record nonuniform regions and feet. Godot renderers sample a stable 32/64-pixel canvas and nearest 16-color palette; discard alpha below 0.5. No Python raster editing.
limitations: First production candidate, not final human art acceptance.
Five drawn walk directions; three mirrored. Four stride poses per drawn direction.
Two battle poses per front/back view; no attack/hurt/faint sheets.
Art preview only: not selectable saved starters or changed species rules.
